text: {"lessons":["Selling Stock A above my average cost felt rewarding, but a gain alone is not a reason to sell; I should consider the position’s role in my portfolio.","My account value fell overall despite a profitable sale and later purchases, reminding me that realized gains and buying more do not guarantee protection from losses.","Several months of declines can feel unsettling, but price movements are random; I should avoid reacting to recent changes and make decisions based on risk and diversification."]}
